transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling card member services. My name is Julian. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi, my name is Beatrix Holloway. I'm calling because there's a charge on my account that I didn't make, and I need to figure out what to do about it.
Agent: Hello, Ms. Holloway. I can certainly look into that for you. For verification, could you confirm your billing zip code and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Sure, the zip code is 48226, and the last four digits are 1044.
Agent: Thank you. Could you share the merchant name, the date, and the amount of the charge in question?
Customer: It's from VoltWorks Electronics on September 25th for $899.00.
Agent: I see that transaction on September 25th for $899.00 from VoltWorks Electronics. Can you tell me a little more about what happened?
Customer: Well, my adult brother was staying with me for a couple of weeks, and it turns out he bought a laptop with my card.
Agent: Did you give your brother permission to use your card for that laptop?
Customer: No, absolutely not. I never let him use it. He just took it while I wasn't looking and placed the order.
Agent: Have you spoken with him about this purchase since finding out?
Customer: I did. He admitted he used the card to buy a laptop for himself without asking me.
Agent: Do you currently have the card in your possession?
Customer: Yes, I have it right here in my wallet. He moved back to his own place last week.
Agent: All right. So to make sure I have everything noted correctly, on September 25th, an $899.00 purchase was made at VoltWorks Electronics for a laptop by your adult brother while he was staying with you, and you never gave him consent to use the card.
Customer: Yes, that's exactly what happened.
